svg.text: GDP per Capita and Human Development: Viet Nam in Global Context
Latest available cross-section: HDI 2023 from UNDP/HDR 2025; GDP per capita 2024 from World Bank WDI.
GDP per capita is PPP 2021 international dollars; the x-axis uses a log scale.
GDP per capita, PPP 2021 international dollars, log scale
Sources: UNDP Human Development Report 2025 HDI time series through Our World in Data Grapher; World Bank WDI GDP per capita series through Our World in Data Grapher.
